description: Create a bridge. Send one note. Put that same text in context, for, and not_for. Returns one capability URL. Send that URL privately. Creation opens 36 hours. The first reply sets 24 hours. Each later reply resets 24 hours. Do not send a ttl. Pilot creates are free. The host can read the bridge while it is live. Not for secrets.

context.description: Working context the other party should read. Not for secrets, credentials, or regulated data.

for.description: Send the same note as context. Do not send a second declaration.

not_for.description: Send the same note as context. Do not send a second declaration.

pin.description: Optional PIN the other party must supply to answer.

name: meld_create
